messages:
incident-bot: [P1] ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeout rate detected on Dedicated cluster dc-eu-03 for tenant=bluecrest. Error rate spike starts at ~1783001100. Routing errors, 502/504, and timeouts observed. Automated mitigation: none yet. Links: https://observability.internal/reports/dc-eu-03/1783001122 :rotating_light:

sam: picking this up — I'm oncall. Checking dashboards now. Can someone post recent infra events?

jia: I see a big CPU and GPU memory pressure on nodes in nodepool-gpu-3. Pod restarts and OOMs around 1783001050-1783001080. Also many long tail latencies in kv-cache access.

mike: bluecrest-support (on call at midday) reports customer seeing 5xx in production for the payment routing flow. They're seeing ~15% request failure rate, user impact ongoing. Ticket #BC-472 created.

sam: okay. First hypothesis: noisy neighbor causing eviction/backpressure on the tenant's dedicated pool. Steps: 1) confirm per-tenant resource usage 2) reduce bluecrest ingress if needed 3) fail over to fallback model variant or reduce model size.

karina: ran `kubectl top nodes --selector=pool=nodepool-gpu-3` — nodes 3/6 at >95% mem on GPU and host. Pod list shows `bluecrest-inference-` pods consuming high GPU mem and `batch-analytics-bluecrest` background jobs spiking concurrent batches.

sam: can we throttle batch jobs for bluecrest? Those should be low priority.

jia: issuing throttle via our quota controller. Command: ```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/tenants/bluecrest/actions -d '{"action":"set_priority","value":"low","target":"batch-analytics"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```

incident-bot: Action logged: set_priority low for batch-analytics (actor=jia, id=act_0b3f).

karina: throttled batch-analytics to 10% concurrency. Observability shows a drop in concurrent GPU jobs for bluecrest within 30s.

mike: customer seeing slight improvement but still intermittent 502s on payment flow. They report 10% failure now.

sam: next we should apply tenant-level rate limiting on spikes to protect control plane and fall back to smaller model variant. Jia, can you trigger model fallback?

jia: rolling a config to pin bluecrest to model=redwood-small-latency for tolerant endpoints, leaving critical endpoints pinned to large model with circuit-breaker. Deploy command: ```json
{"tenant":"bluecrest","routes":{"/api/*/payment":{"model":"redwood-small-latency","circuit_breaker":true},"/api/*/chat":{"model":"redwood-large","circuit_breaker":false}}}
```

incident-bot: Config change queued (cfg_9823). Will apply to dc-eu-03 via canary.

karina: applying canary to 2 nodes now. Monitoring latency/5xx.

sam: please also enforce gateway-level short-circuit: 3xx/429 fallback to cached response for repeat requests.

jia: added gateway rule: ```yaml
- match: "/api/*/payment"
  max_retries: 1
  failure_action: "fallback_cached"
  rate_limit: 200rps
```

incident-bot: Gateway rule applied by jia (rule_44f).

mike: bluecrest reports errors subsided to ~3-5% over last 3m. Customer impact reduced but still not fully resolved. They're escalating to SOC.

sam: good. Need capacity relief too — nodes in nodepool-gpu-3 are degraded. Karina, can we spin up temporary burst nodes from spare pool or migrate some low-priority tenants off this nodepool?

karina: spinning up 2 spare instances in eu-west-1 (burst-gpu-2). ETA ~2m. Also initiating migration of non-critical tenants: `migrate-tenant --selector=priority:low --target=nodepool-gpu-4` (this will take ~5m).

incident-bot: New instance creation started (inst_burst_77). Migration job 309 queued.

sam: timeline: throttles + fallback applied ~1783001160, burst nodes requested ~1783001180. Check metrics at 1783001220 for improvement.

jia: metrics at 1783001220 show request error rate down to ~2% and p95 latency back to baseline for payment route using fallback. KV cache hit rate improved after lower concurrency.

mike: Customer confirms production traffic is stable for the moment. They're asking for root cause and ETA for full resolution.

sam: immediate mitigation complete. Root cause likely combination of background batch jobs overconsuming GPU mem and degraded KV cache causing long tail latencies -> gateway timeouts. We'll keep burst nodes up for 24h and plan a full remediation.

karina: logs attached: ```
[1783001054] pod bluecrest-inference-7 OOMKilled (gpu mem)
[1783001061] pod batch-analytics-bluecrest-3 started 8 concurrent jobs
[1783001070] kv-cache latency spike: 1200ms
[1783001085] gateway 502: upstream timeout
```

sam: okay, if bluecrest still has errors after migrations, we'll do a controlled eviction of any remaining noisy pods in that nodepool. But try to avoid data loss.

mike: raising a follow-up with customer success to communicate mitigation steps and timeline. I'll coordinate a post-incident call.

jia: follow-ups for eng-runtime: add per-tenant soft limits on batch job concurrency, improve controller visibility for GPU mem pressure, and add auto-fallback to smaller model variant when node-level GPU pressure >90%.

karina: SRE follow-ups: automated migration playbook, faster node spin-up for burst capacity, and alert tuning to reduce noise.

sam: handoff: I'm leaving in 15m, @karina will take lead for the night. Karina, please continue monitoring and ping if errors reappear.

karina: ACK. I'll keep track and create an incident channel update at +1h with metrics and timeline. Also will collect OOM pod core dumps for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigation_in_progress -> stabilized (1783001260). Pager closed for oncall-sam. Escalation: none.

sam: thanks team. Quick incident note: Cause = tenant batch jobs + cache pressure -> noisy neighbor / capacity exhaustion on nodepool-gpu-3. Short term fixes: throttle batch jobs, model fallback, add burst nodes. Next steps: permanent soft limits, auto-fallback policy, and customer postmortem in 48h.

mike: I'll schedule customer postmortem and share notes. Bluecrest wants incident summary and confirmed they will throttle some of their internal jobs as well.

karina: creating ticket INFRA-2894 for migration playbook and INFRA-2895 for alert tuning.

sam: handing off to @karina. If anything regresses ping here or call me. :thumbsup:
